title: ALS: Life Sciences Stays Soft
caption:
The Announcement Room | ALS Limited (ALQ)

According to the Vitti Capital Daily Mover dated 23 November 2026, ALS Limited shares fell 12.0% in morning trade to $16.99.

Vitti points to three possible drivers of the move:
• H1 Life Sciences organic growth of 1.8% confirms the softer FY27 trajectory
• EBITDA cash conversion fell to 82.4% from 88.0% on bigger working capital
• Record Commodities growth (+24.5%) couldn't offset Life Sciences woes

Key points:
• FY27 life SCI growth GUID.: ~3%
• H1 life SCI organic growth: 1.8%
• EBITDA cash conversion: 82.4%
• H2 Minerals growth expected to moderate against tougher FY26 H2 comparative
• Minerals margin targeted to improve 20-30bps in H2 FY27 above H1 margin

Looking ahead, Vitti flags three key risks: Life Sciences recovery, cash conversion gap and minerals comp cycling.

In this two-page investor report, we look at:
• What may have driven the move
• What changes now
• How we got here
• Key risks and the Vitti view
